builds.name: Euphoria Alchemy

mutation.name: Euphoria
mutation.description: Increases sword damage and Sign intensity by 0.75% for each point of Toxicity.

builds.toxicityStrategy: The Toxicity Threshold: your safety threshold is now 80% (down from 95%+). Exceeding 80% causes your health to drain. You will intentionally sit exactly at or just over 80% to maximize the Euphoria buff while counteracting the health drain using health-regen decoctions.
builds.slotNote: 16 skill slots total. To unlock all four central mutation slots, research at least 8 mutations in the expansion tree.

skills.name: Acquired Tolerance
skills.description: Grants essential maximum toxicity based on known recipes.

skills.name: Synergy
skills.description: Increases the bonus of equipped mutagens in your character panel by 50%.

skills.name: Killing Spree
skills.description: Boosts critical hit chance by 30% per killed enemy during a fight.

skills.name: Hunter Instinct
skills.description: Boosts critical hit damage by 100% when adrenaline is fully maxed.

skills.name: Protective Coating
skills.description: Adds 15% damage resistance against the targeted monster type when the correct oil is applied.

skills.name: Fixative
skills.description: Blade oils never wear off and you can stack up to three oils simultaneously on a single blade.

skills.name: Muscle Memory
skills.description: Maximizes fast attack damage.

skills.name: Precise Blows
skills.description: Maximizes fast attack critical hit chance/damage.

skills.name: Strength Training
skills.description: Maximizes strong attack damage.

skills.name: Crushing Blows
skills.description: Maximizes strong attack critical hit chance/damage.

skills.name: Whirl
skills.description: Continuous multi-target fast attack.

skills.name: Rend
skills.description: High-damage strong attack that bypasses enemy shields.

skills.name: Razor Focus
skills.description: Instantly builds 1 Adrenaline Point when entering combat.

skills.name: Resolve
skills.description: Prevents losing Adrenaline Points when taking damage.

skills.name: Metabolic Control
skills.description: Crucial +30 to max toxicity to offset patch balance changes.

skills.name: Cat School Techniques
skills.description: Grants 25% critical hit damage and 5% fast attack damage per piece of Light armor.

builds.mutagens: Equip 4 Greater Red Mutagens to get the massive damage multipliers boosted by Synergy.

consumables.rotationNote: Drink your long-lasting decoctions first, then top off your remaining toxicity with short-term combat potions right before engagement.

decoctions.name: Ekimmara Decoction
decoctions.description: Restores health when dealing damage to enemies. Completely negates toxic health drain.

decoctions.name: Water Hag Decoction
decoctions.description: Boosts your raw damage output by 50% as long as your health is full.

decoctions.name: Arachas Decoction
decoctions.description: Reduces incoming damage based on how light your armor/inventory weight is.

decoctions.name: Succubus Decoction
decoctions.description: Steadily increases your attack power over the duration of the fight.

potions.name: Superior Tawny Owl
potions.description: Speeds up Stamina regeneration for continuous Whirl and Rend.

potions.name: Superior Blizzard
potions.description: Slows down time when an enemy is killed, allowing for infinite stamina attacks if you maintain 3 Adrenaline points.

builds.name: Metamorphosis Combat-Alchemy "God" Build

mutation.name: Metamorphosis
mutation.description: Relies on high critical-hit chance to rapidly trigger up to 5 already-brewed decoctions for free (0 Toxicity cost), turning you into a damage-and-sustain machine without ever filling your toxicity bar.

builds.toxicityStrategy: Unlike Euphoria, this build doesn't sit near the toxicity threshold — Metamorphosis-triggered decoctions cost 0 Toxicity, so your bar stays clear for standard combat potions instead.
builds.slotNote: 12 main skill slots and 4 mutation slots, split between the Combat and Alchemy trees. Use 4 Greater Red Mutagens to maximize attack power.

skills.name: Muscle Memory
skills.description: Maximum fast attack damage and critical hit chance.

skills.name: Precise Blows
skills.description: Maximum fast attack critical hit chance.

skills.name: Crushing Blows
skills.description: For heavy armor enemies.

skills.name: Rend
skills.description: Bypasses shields and guarantees high critical chance.

skills.name: Whirl
skills.description: Mandatory. Your primary mechanism to apply rapid hits, instantly triggering critical effects to activate your decoctions.

skills.name: Razor Focus
skills.description: Instantly gives you an adrenaline point entering combat, and generates them rapidly via Whirl.

skills.name: Sunder Armor (Optional)
skills.description: Helps shred bosses or heavy monsters quickly.

skills.name: Acquired Tolerance
skills.description: Nerfed in 4.0, but still required to give you enough toxicity to drink your standard potions.

skills.name: Tissue Transmutation
skills.description: Grants you thousands of extra HP automatically as Metamorphosis forces decoctions to activate.

skills.name: Protective Coating
skills.description: Grants a permanent 15% damage resistance against the monster type matching your applied oil.

skills.name: Synergy
skills.description: Mandatory. Boosts the effectiveness of your equipped mutagens by 50% — Red Mutagens jump from +10% to +15% attack power each.

skills.name: Killing Spree
skills.description: Increases your critical hit chance by 50% for every enemy killed. Essential for group fights.

skills.name: Hunter Instinct (Optional)
skills.description: Grants extra critical damage when adrenaline is full (patch 4.0 corrected this skill so it finally functions as intended).

skills.name: Cat School Techniques
skills.description: Increases critical hit damage by 25% and fast attack damage by 5% for each piece of Light Armor equipped.

builds.mutagens: Use 4 Greater Red Mutagens to maximize your attack power, boosted further by Synergy.

gear.name: Aerondight

gear.name: Toussaint Knight's Steel Sword

enchantments.name: Levity

enchantments.name: Severance

consumables.rotationNote: Metamorphosis only pulls from decoctions you've actually crafted — don't craft ones outside this list, or clear out extras if you can. The Open: apply the correct oil, cast Quen. The Trigger: dash in and hold Whirl — near-100% crit chance means the first ~2 seconds of spinning triggers Metamorphosis, flooding you with up to 5 active decoctions (HP pool expands via Tissue Transmutation, damage spikes). The Chug: since those decoctions cost 0 Toxicity, your bar is clear — drink Superior Thunderbolt, Superior Blizzard, and Superior Maribor Forest.

decoctions.name: Water Hag Decoction
decoctions.description: Increases damage by 50% when your HP is at maximum.

decoctions.name: Ekimmara Decoction
decoctions.description: Restores HP whenever you deal damage (constant life-steal).

decoctions.name: Arachas Decoction
decoctions.description: Reduces damage taken based on your armor/inventory weight — synergizes heavily with heavy Ursine armor.

decoctions.name: Ekhidna Decoction
decoctions.description: Regenerates HP whenever you perform actions that consume stamina (casting Quen, spinning with Whirl).

decoctions.name: Chort / Succubus Decoction
decoctions.description: For stagger immunity, or scaling attack power over time.
